title: [CPP FakeTensor] add Fake dispatch key to various places

items.author: ezyang
items.body: Why do we mask Fake here?

items.author: ezyang
items.body: I would appreciate it explicitly reasoned out (you can ask your LLM to do this) why each particular insertion makes sense.

items.author: ezyang
items.body:
> **Astra agent review (AI-generated)**
>
> **[P2] Masking `Fake` also weakens guards on explicit `DispatchKeySet` arguments**
>
> `DISPATCH_KEY_SET_MATCH` also uses `LocalState.apply()`, so this change makes `CPU` and `CPU|Fake` compare equal. However, Dynamo constant-folds `dks.has("Fake")`. For example:
>
> ```python
> @torch.compile(backend="eager", fullgraph=True)
> def fn(x, dks):
>     return x + 1 if dks.has("Fake") else x - 1
> ```
>
> Calling first with `CPU`, then with `CPU|Fake`, can reuse the `x - 1` graph when `x + 1` is required.
>
> Restrict Fake masking to tensor guards, or preserve exact equality for explicit keyset arguments. Add a regression test covering this transition.
>
> **Request changes.** Verified by source tracing; no local PyTorch build was available to execute the reproducer.
